title: International Relocation Salary Gap Report 2026
subtitle: Mathematical analysis of gross compensation differentials required to break even across premier international migration corridors.
metaDescription: Discover the required salary adjustment when moving between London, Dubai, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and Sydney under 2026 statutory tax and living cost regimes.
citationString: LivWorthy Research Institute. (2026). International Relocation Salary Gap Report 2026. https://www.livworthy.com/reports/relocation-salary-gap
methodologyNotes: Break-even compensation is computed using the LivWorthy deterministic inverse solver matching origin net disposable savings.
Models single professionals renting median 1-bedroom apartments in destination urban centers.
Considers first-year relocation friction including visa processing, security deposits, and international transit.

primarySources.name: IRS, HMRC, FTA, ATO, CRA Tax Bulletins

summaryInsights: Employees relocating from London to Dubai can take a 12% lower gross package while still increasing their net disposable savings by over £15,000 annually.
Moving from New York to London requires an 18% compensatory markup to preserve equivalent dollar-for-dollar purchasing power.
The San Francisco to Austin corridor represents the largest domestic US break-even dividend (-21% required gross for identical quality of life).
